info.title: Record Enrichment API
info.description: Collect work, location, shift and salary details from your own candidate database. You need two things: your **key id** and your **secret**. Everything else is generated. See Authentication for how.

post.description:
Create the questions you want candidates to answer and the window they are contacted in. It is created once and never edited: different questions mean a new enrichment. Returns `enrichment_id`. Record prepares translations and voice in the background: read the enrichment until `questions_status` is `ready`.

**Scope:** `enrichment:write` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

external_id.description: Your own id (1 to 128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -)

language.description: Opening language of messages and calls (the candidate can switch)

days.description: Days messages and calls may go out, each listed once

schedule.description: Required. Send all six: `language` (english, hindi, tamil, kannada, telugu, malayalam), `start_time` and `end_time` ("HH:MM", start before end), `days` (mon…sun, each once), `timezone` (IANA), `max_retries` 1 to 20, `retry_after_hours` 1 to 48.

question_text.description: What Record asks the candidate, up to 300 characters

type.description: yes_no is answered with a tap, voice is spoken or recorded

preferred_answer.description: Required for yes_no: the answer that counts as qualified

required.description: A candidate completes only after answering every required question

questions.description: 1 to 15 questions. An enrichment is never edited: different questions mean a new enrichment

questions.question_text: Are you open to a new job right now?
Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.

questions_status.description: Translation and voice of the questions. Campaigns wait for ready, then go out by themselves; failed is retried when you create a campaign

sent.description: Candidates whose WhatsApp invite went out

completed.description: Candidates who finished, including those who declined

is_external.description: true when created through the Partner API, false when made in the Record playground

questions.question_text: Are you open to a new job right now?
Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: `name`, `schedule` or `questions` missing, a `yes_no` question without `preferred_answer`, `start_time` not before `end_time`, an unknown language, empty or repeated `days`, or an unknown field.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: A TEST key's organisation already has 5 active enrichments. Archive one in the Record playground.

409.description: `CONFLICT`: `external_id` is already used by another enrichment.

        "days": [
            "mon",

        ],
        "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata",

    },

        {
            "question_text": "Are you open to a new job right now?",

post.description:
Add candidates (name and mobile number) to one of your enrichments. Record starts contacting them straight away: there is no separate start step. If the questions are still being prepared, the campaign waits and goes out by itself. Returns `campaign_id`, the candidates and every row that was skipped. Credits are charged per candidate added and checked for the whole batch first.

**Scope:** `enrichment:campaigns` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

> **This contacts real candidates.** Build against a TEST key first.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

language.description: Invite language; defaults to the enrichment's schedule language

phone_number.description: An Indian mobile number: 10 digits, or with +91

external_id.description: Your own id for the candidate; returned with their status and results

candidates.description: Required. 1 to 1,000 of `{ name, phone_number, external_id? }`. `phone_number` is an Indian mobile: 10 digits, or with `+91`. A row with an invalid number, a number that opted out, or a number already earlier in the list is skipped and returned in `skipped`; it never fails the call. `external_id` comes back on every candidate and result.

201.description: The new campaign, its candidates and the rows skipped

awaiting_questions.description: true while the questions are still being prepared; nothing goes out until they are

index.description: Position in the candidates you sent, from 0

skipped.description: Every row left out and why. Skipped rows are never an error

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: No candidate has a contactable number (`details` say why), or a field is missing or unknown.

402.description: `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`: The organisation's credits do not cover every candidate in the batch (live wallet for a live key, test wallet for a TEST key). Nothing is created.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: A TEST key would exceed 50 candidates in this enrichment.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: No such enrichment, or it is archived.

429.description: `DAILY_CAP`: The key has put its daily allowance of different people into campaigns (2,000, or 200 for a TEST key). Resets at midnight IST.

post.description:
Stop everything still to go out (invites, follow-ups, SMS, calls) until you resume. Only a live campaign can be paused, and one whose candidates have all finished has nothing left to pause.

**Scope:** `enrichment:campaigns` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

awaiting_questions.description: true while the questions are still being prepared; nothing goes out until they are

409.description: `CONFLICT`: The campaign is not live, or every candidate has already finished.

get.description:
The credits your organisation can spend on enrichments, in the wallet of the key you signed with: a `VFN_TEST_` key sees the test wallet and a `VFN_LIVE_` key the live one. `unit_price` is what one candidate costs and `candidates_affordable` is how many more the balance covers. A campaign that costs more than the balance is refused with `402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS` and nothing is created. This call changes nothing. With no billing account or no test wallet you still get `200`, with `billing_configured` or `wallet_configured` false and `wallet` null.

**Scope:** `enrichment:credits`

200.description: The wallet, the price of one candidate and what the balance covers

mode.description: Which wallet this is: the mode of the key you signed with

currency.description: 1 credit is 1 unit of this currency

billing_configured.description: false when your organisation has no billing account yet

wallet_configured.description: false when this wallet was never set up (a test wallet on an older account). Nothing can be spent from it

wallet.description: null when billing or this wallet is not set up

unit_price.description: Credits one candidate costs when added to an enrichment campaign. null when no price is set

candidates_affordable.description: How many more candidates the balance covers at the current price. null when the wallet or price is unknown

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
x-codeSamples.source:
const res = await call("GET", "/api/v1/partner/enrichment-credits");
const { data } = await res.json();

get.summary: Where your enrichment credits were used
get.description:
One row for every candidate added to an enrichment campaign, newest first, in the wallet of the key you signed with. `credits` is negative when credits were spent and positive when they were given back. `summary.net_credits` adds up every row that matches your filters, not only the page you are on. An id from another organisation returns an empty list. This call changes nothing.

**Scope:** `enrichment:credits`

parameters.name: enrichment_id
parameters.description: Only credits spent in this enrichment

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Only credits spent in this campaign

parameters.name: candidate_id
parameters.description: Only credits spent on this candidate

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only rows from this moment on (included)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only rows before this moment (not included)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 100, default 25

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

200.description: One page, newest first, with the net of everything that matches

type.description: debit when a candidate was added, refund or adjustment for a correction

description.description: What the credits were spent on

credits.description: Credits moved: negative when spent, positive when given back

unit_price.description: Price per candidate at that time

balance_after.description: The wallet's balance right after this row

enrichment_id.description: The enrichment the candidate belongs to

campaign_id.description: The campaign the candidate was added to

candidate_id.description: The candidate the credits were spent on

count.description: How many items this page holds

total.description: How many items match your filters across all pages. null when that cannot be counted cheaply: a filter worked out per item (status, progress) on a list that is large

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page

has_more.description: true while there is a next page (with a status or progress filter that page can still come back empty)

net_credits.description: The sum of `credits` over every row that matches your filters, not only this page

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
x-codeSamples.source:
const res = await call("GET", "/api/v1/partner/enrichment-credits/usage?enrichment_id=WF_EN_261121094822026AEDRUB86TQVSML&campaign_id=EC_261121095438377TFUX07WN2XT42V&from=2026-11-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z&limit=25");
const { data } = await res.json();

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Your key id, `VFN_TEST_…` or `VFN_LIVE_…`. Sent on every request.

SecretKey.name: x-secret-key
SecretKey.description: Your secret, `VFN_SK_…`. **Not a real header, and never sent to the API.** It is only a form field for Try it, which uses it to sign your request in your browser. In your own code you sign each request with the secret and send `x-api-key`, `x-timestamp` and `x-signature` (see Authentication).
